biography: Mike West's journey into motorsport began, not on the karting track like many of his peers, but in the virtual world of sim racing. Spending countless hours honing his skills on a rudimentary setup in his childhood bedroom, Mike developed an uncanny ability to anticipate track conditions and extract every last ounce of performance from his digital machines. His break came when he won a national sim racing championship, earning him a scholarship to a Ginetta racing academy. The transition from pixels to asphalt was challenging, but Mike's innate talent and relentless dedication quickly shone through. A defining moment came during a particularly wet race at Brands Hatch, where his masterful car control in treacherous conditions saw him climb from last to finish on the podium. Currently, Mike is competing in the Ginetta GT4 SuperCup, aiming to prove his consistency and catch the eye of bigger teams. Although a podium contender, Mike is sometimes held back by a defensive mindset, which can limit his overtaking opportunities.
drivingStyle: Mike's driving style is characterized by a cautious, calculated approach. He excels at maintaining consistent lap times and preserving his tires, often opting for a defensive line to protect his position. While not the most aggressive overtaker, Mike is incredibly difficult to pass, making him a formidable opponent in races of attrition. He prefers to let the race come to him, capitalizing on the mistakes of others rather than forcing the issue. This strategy can sometimes cost him valuable positions in the short-term, but Mike believes in playing the long game, banking on his ability to outlast the competition.
